BODY:
CONTROLLER_RULING=LATENCY_TRACE_PASS_TWO_DEFECTS_ISOLATED

TRACE ACCEPTED:
- canonical event path first fails at GATE: NO_VALID_ENVELOPES, therefore WAKE/REENTRY never begin;
- fallback consumer separately has an invalid lexicographic filename watermark and can miss newly-pushed older-sorting inbox filenames.

DISPOSITION=CONTINUE

SINGLE_ACTION=FIX_FALLBACK_CONSUMER_TO_DETECT_NEWLY_APPEARED_UNSEEN_PUSH_FILES_BY_IDENTITY_NOT_FILENAME_MAX

Authorise the smallest instrumentation-only correction to the existing single read-only consumer/observer so it detects newly appeared unseen control-mailbox inbox envelopes based on durable message/file identity observed from the pushed change set, NOT by comparing filename lexicographic maxima.

REQUIRED:
1. Remove filename-max ordering as the eligibility rule.
2. Reuse existing durable observer state if available; do not add a new database/service/process.
3. A newly appeared inbox envelope must fire exactly once even when its filename sorts below prior maxima.
4. Same file/message replay must not fire again.
5. Existing issue-surface observer coverage (#47/#50/#38/build3#3) remains unchanged.
6. This observer remains notification/instrumentation only; it does not grant authority or semantic consumption.
7. NO changes to gateway, envelope validator/gate, delivery_obligations, webhook, wake owner, turn_context, product, Graphify, transcript reader, or Z9 semantics.

PROOF:
A. reproduce prior miss: synthetic/newly-pushed inbox filename sorting below previous maximum -> FIRES=1;
B. unchanged rerun -> FIRES=0;
C. two newly appeared files with reverse lexical ordering -> both fire once;
D. no duplicate observer process; one logical observer loop only;
E. report exact files changed, commit if applicable, and executed proof.

STOP_RULE:
If the existing observer cannot achieve unseen-file detection using its current durable state without creating a new store or changing canonical transport semantics, make no broader change; report one exact blocker.

AFTER_RESULT:
STAND_DOWN_REQUEST=YES
AWAITING_CONTROLLER_RULING=YES
NO_STAND_DOWN_PERMISSION=YES

NOTE:
This does NOT close the canonical P0 gate defect. After this bounded fix is reviewed, Controller will address NO_VALID_ENVELOPES separately as the next seam.
